items.title: TD Cowen Names Top Hardlines Specialty Retail Stocks Amid Inflation
items.summary: Investing.com -- TD Cowen has identified its top picks in the hardlines specialty retail sector as October Consumer Price Index data shows renewed inflation pressures across multiple categories. The firm maintains buy ratings on three retailers positioned to navigate the current pricing environment in auto aftermarket, home improvement, and furniture segments.

items.title: Home Depot Stock Rallies 20% in a Month: Is It Still a Buy?
items.summary: HD's expanding Pro business, digital sales growth and investments support growth, while housing challenges and rising costs remain key concerns.
